thread:
jordan: Observed ~7% drop in prefix cache hitrate on prod after yesterday's kernel selector change. Traces show more cold KV cache fills and ~12ms p50 extra latency on short-chat flows. Anyone else seeing this? :eyes:

matt: Yep saw a spike around 05:12 UTC. Can you paste a minimal repro or a sample request that missed cache?

jordan: Here's an example payload (sanitized). The only diff vs previous was kernel_selector=dynamic_sample_v2
```
{ "system": "You are an assistant", "user": "short question", "tools": [{"name":"lookup","args":{"q":"weather"}}], "tokenizer_id": "tknr-v5", "kernel": "dynamic_sample_v2" }
```

priya: ran a trace. The cache key builder concatenates system + user + serialized tools + tokenizer_id. The problem: tool args are not normalized (order varies) and tokenizer_id sometimes comes as `tknr-v5` vs `tknr-v5-2026-02` depending on caller. That makes identical prompts different keys.

sasha: strong +1 to pin tokenizer version in key or normalize to base id. Also we should canonicalize tool arg ordering. Small patch: replace tools serialization with stable sort by name and JSON-dump with separators=(',',':') — reduces churn.

benchbot: perf-run 6161: A/B with canonicalize-tools + tokenizer-normalize => cache hit +5.8% p50 latency -9ms on the short-chat cohort. Full logs: https://ci/internal/617

matt: kernel_selector change might have changed batching heuristics too, causing different tokenization paths (fast-vs-safe) to be picked which flip tokenizer_id. We need to ensure kernel selection doesn't alter high-level key-significant fields.

priya: Agreed. Two proposals: 1) normalize key: strip tokenizer build metadata and stable-sort tool args; 2) pin tokenizer version in caller SDKs to avoid variety. Also add a short TTL bump to give warmup a chance while we roll out fixes.

jordan: I'll open an issue with repro + attach trace. For warmup: can we prefill the KV cache for top 200 prefixes using the prefill script (sasha, can you run)? We'll monitor hitrate and kernel routing after patch roll.

sasha: can run prefill tonight in staging. Also will send a tiny patch to keygen: deterministic tool order + tokenizer base id. Will run unit tests and a small perf-check.

matt: I'll add a temporary routing fallback: if key-miss rate for a prefix > 20% and latency spike, route that cohort to legacy_kernel until stable.

priya: add a regression alert to perf-dashboard for cache-hit delta > -3% over 10m so we catch next time earlier.

jordan: thanks. Issue: INF-2029. Will update thread with results. :thumbsup:
